SELECT SS.TEST_SET_ID , ROUND(AVG(SS.STUDENT_SCORE), 1) AS AVERAGE_SCORE FROM (SELECT TA.TEST_SET_ID , TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , AS STUDENT_SCORE , AS PENDING_COUNT FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TA.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN "USER" U ON U.ID = CS.USER_ID WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND CS.USER_ID = TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID AND U.DEL_YN = 'N') GROUP BY TA.TEST_SET_ID , TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID) SS GROUP BY SS.TEST_SET_ID HAVING SUM(SS.PENDING_COUNT) = 0

SELECT SS.TEST_SET_ID , SS.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , SS.STUDENT_SCORE , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SS.TEST_SET_ID ORDER BY SS.STUDENT_SCORE DESC) AS RANK_NO , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY SS.TEST_SET_ID) AS RANK_TOTAL , SUM(SS.PENDING_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY SS.TEST_SET_ID) AS TOTAL_PENDING FROM (SELECT TA.TEST_SET_ID , TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , AS STUDENT_SCORE , AS PENDING_COUNT FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TA.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN "USER" U ON U.ID = CS.USER_ID WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND CS.USER_ID = TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID AND U.DEL_YN = 'N') GROUP BY TA.TEST_SET_ID , TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID) SS

SELECT TS.ID AS TEST_SET_ID , TS.SET_NAME , TS.TEST_TYPE , TS.SHOW_YN , TP.TOTAL_POINT , MA.SCORE , MA.PENDING_COUNT , CA.AVERAGE_SCORE , RK.RANK_NO , RK.RANK_TOTAL FROM TEST_SET TS INNER JOIN (SELECT TST.TEST_SET_ID , SUM(NVL(T.POINT_ALLOC, 0)) AS TOTAL_POINT FROM TEST_SET_TESTS TST INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TST.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TST.TEST_SET_ID) TP ON TP.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT TA.TEST_SET_ID , AS SCORE , AS PENDING_COUNT FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TA.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = #{userId} AND T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TA.TEST_SET_ID) MA ON MA.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN () CA ON CA.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN () RK ON RK.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID AND RK.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = #{userId} AND RK.TOTAL_PENDING = 0 WHERE TS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND (TS.SHOW_YN = 'Y' OR MA.TEST_SET_ID IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY TS.ID ASC

SELECT CS.ID AS COURSE_STUDENT_ID , CS.USER_ID , U.NAME AS USER_NAME , AS NAME_SUFFIX , TS.ID AS TEST_SET_ID , TS.SET_NAME , TS.TEST_TYPE , TP.TOTAL_POINT , SA.SCORE , SA.PENDING_COUNT , CA.AVERAGE_SCORE FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN "USER" U ON U.ID = CS.USER_ID INNER JOIN TEST_SET TS ON TS.COURSE_ID = CS.COURSE_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT TST.TEST_SET_ID , SUM(NVL(T.POINT_ALLOC, 0)) AS TOTAL_POINT FROM TEST_SET_TESTS TST INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TST.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TST.TEST_SET_ID) TP ON TP.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , TA.TEST_SET_ID , AS SCORE , AS PENDING_COUNT FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TA.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , TA.TEST_SET_ID) SA ON SA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = CS.USER_ID AND SA.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN () CA ON CA.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY U.NAME ASC , TS.ID ASC

SELECT TS.ID AS TEST_SET_ID , TS.SET_NAME , TS.TEST_TYPE , TS.SHOW_YN , (SELECT NAME FROM "USER" WHERE ID = #{userId}) AS USER_NAME , (SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(TA.CRT_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA WHERE TA.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID AND TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = #{userId}) AS SUBMITTED_AT , (SELECT SUM(NVL(T.POINT_ALLOC, 0)) FROM TEST_SET_TESTS TST INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TST.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE TST.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID AND T.DEL_YN = 'N') AS TOTAL_POINT , MA.SCORE , MA.PENDING_COUNT FROM TEST_SET TS LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT TA.TEST_SET_ID , AS SCORE , AS PENDING_COUNT FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TA.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = #{userId} AND TA.TEST_SET_ID = #{testSetId} AND T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TA.TEST_SET_ID) MA ON MA.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID WHERE TS.ID = #{testSetId} AND TS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId}

SELECT T.ID AS TEST_ID , T.QUESTION , T.SUB_QUESTION , T.ANSWER_TYPE , T.ANSWER_SHEET_1 AS ANSWER_SHEET1 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_2 AS ANSWER_SHEET2 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_3 AS ANSWER_SHEET3 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_4 AS ANSWER_SHEET4 , T.ANSWER_SHEET_5 AS ANSWER_SHEET5 , NVL(T.POINT_ALLOC, 0) AS POINT_ALLOC , T.CORRECT_ANSWER , TA.ANSWER , TA.IS_CORRECT , CASE WHEN TA.IS_CORRECT = 'Y' THEN NVL(T.POINT_ALLOC, 0) WHEN TA.IS_CORRECT = 'H' THEN LEAST(2, NVL(T.POINT_ALLOC, 0)) WHEN TA.IS_CORRECT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END AS EARNED_POINT FROM TEST_SET_TESTS TST INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TST.TEST_ID = T.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TEST_ANSWERS TA ON TA.TEST_SET_ID = TST.TEST_SET_ID AND TA.TEST_ID = T.ID AND TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = #{userId} WHERE TST.TEST_SET_ID = #{testSetId} AND T.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY T.ID ASC

SELECT AV.USER_ID , ROUND(AV.AVERAGE_PERCENT, 1) AS AVERAGE_PERCENT , AV.TEST_COUNT , RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AV.AVERAGE_PERCENT DESC) AS RANK_NO , COUNT(*) OVER () AS RANK_TOTAL FROM (SELECT RK.COURSE_STUDENT_ID AS USER_ID , AVG(RK.STUDENT_SCORE * 100 / TP.TOTAL_POINT) AS AVERAGE_PERCENT , COUNT(*) AS TEST_COUNT FROM () RK INNER JOIN TEST_SET TS ON TS.ID = RK.TEST_SET_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT TST.TEST_SET_ID , SUM(NVL(T.POINT_ALLOC, 0)) AS TOTAL_POINT FROM TEST_SET_TESTS TST INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TST.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TST.TEST_SET_ID) TP ON TP.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID WHERE TS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND RK.TOTAL_PENDING = 0 AND TP.TOTAL_POINT > 0 GROUP BY RK.COURSE_STUDENT_ID) AV
SELECT BASE_ROLE FROM "USER" WHERE ID = #{_parameter} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
